A1.description: Two-ink flat graphics on paper; repetition carries information and an open gap breaks the order; a design choice without attribution.

B1.description: A dominant paper base, dark contours and a scarce warm accent; highlights reserve the base and shadows use the dark ink.

B2.description: Uniform flat illumination, without realistic volumetric light; do not infer physical color temperature for flat graphics.

B3.description: An off-center focus leads from an isolated color shape into detail; keep open areas continuous and recompose across domains using the same density logic.

B4.description: The subject forms a compact cluster surrounded by a low-density base, without fixing object or character counts.

C1.description: Uniform fine lines with geometric color planes, clear turns and closed contours without photographic modeling.

C2.description: Crisp focal edges, slightly broken secondary edges and peripheral edges absorbed by the paper base.

C3.description: Concentrate finish on focal structure, simplify secondary areas and leave peripheral decoration sparse.

C4.description: Fine paper fibers remain visible with slight grain at ink boundaries; avoid smooth plastic reflections.

D1.description: Translate any new subject silhouette into the same line and plane grammar while preserving structural meaning.

E1.description: Cluster details locally and keep the periphery sparse; density follows reading order.

E2.description: A small warm shape provides the entry point, structural turns sustain attention and the background remains subordinate.

E3.description: Compact dark line clusters contrast with continuous light paper; a small warm accent disrupts regular repetition.

negative: plastic reflections that conflict with the paper medium

adaptation_bridge.color: Remap native subject colors into the shared base, structure and accent palette; preserve identity through silhouette.
adaptation_bridge.material: Express new materials using fine lines, flat ink and grain; describe seams with lines and highlights with reserved paper.
adaptation_bridge.space: Cluster new subjects within the shared area ranges and group growing sets; preserve text and chart readability, splitting panels when needed.
adaptation_bridge.focus: Prioritize expression and posture; take identity only from the independent series anchor.

theme_slot.subject: a short-haired traveler
theme_slot.layout: Arrange using the locked density grammar
theme_slot.series_anchor: Short hair, a round-collar jacket and a square pocket on the left; preserve these silhouette identifiers in every frame
